code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation, low pO2), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, INR, and mild hyperchloremia. These findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or severe infection, and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are warranted.
